decisions.reason: The aloe vera line builds directly on the firm's core natural formulation know-how and established suppliers, and it has its own page, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it in-house rather than withdraw it.

The hyaluronic acid serum is a close extension of the firm's facial care expertise using well-understood ingredients, and its integrated development lets it absorb feedback and improve the product, even though it is only mentioned on the website.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and draws on the firm's oil-based natural formulation knowledge, so it deserves time for learning, although the earlier withdrawal of the cleansing milk shows the cleansing segment carries some risk.
